questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The priest said, “Death is inevitable.”

options.text: The priest said death had been inevitable.
The priest said that death is inevitable.
The priest said that death was inevitable.
The priest told that death had been inevitable.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **'The priest said that death is inevitable.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** Direct speech** and this is a **universal truth.**
 
• While changing the **narration** of **universal truth, habitual fact or scientific fact,** we need to follow these steps-
 
 
• First off all **remove commas and inverted commas(" ").**
 
• The reporting verb **"said"** remains unchanged.
 
• The conjunction **"that"** is used in **place of commas and inverted commas.**
 
• No changes are made to the **reported verb’s tense**. So here Simple Present Tense **(is)** **will not be change** in Simple Past tense**(was)**.
 
 
 
• **Thus the indirect speech is:__** *The priest said that death is inevitable.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• If the reporting verb is in **past tense**, we make changes to the reported verb as per the below rule:

 
 
• Present continuous tense changes to past continuous tense.
 
• **If there is any universal truth, habitual fact in the reporting speech, no changes are made to the reported verb’s tense.**
 
 
 
• Third **person pronoun does not** change in indirect speech.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The teacher was happy to meet her and asked, “When did you complete all these?”

questions.solution:

__
 
• The given sentence is **Interrogative sentence.**
 
• While changing narration of** interrogative sentences -**
 
 
• ​First off all **remove commas and inverted commas**.
 
• If the reported speech is in the form of **WH-Question** (who/what/why/how/where/when/which etc.), then:
 
 
• To make indirect speech, the question is changed into **assertive (positive) form** and simply placed after the reporting verb.
 
• There is an **inversion **of **subject and verb** during conversion.
 
 
 
• Also, in the given sentence** reporting verb **is in** past tense**, thus we make the following change-
 
 
• **Simple past tense (did)** will change in **Past perfect tense (had)** and in Past perfect tense we use **verb's 3rd form (completed).**

• **"You"** will change to **"she".**
 
 
 
• In given sentence "**these"** is a **time and distance indicator word **so it will change into** 'those'.**
 
• **'Asked' will not change.**
 
• The sign of **interrogation (?)** is removed and full stop is used.
 
• The sentence with the quotation marks under the direct speech,** '****When did you complete all these?'** becomes** 'when she had completed all those'** in indirect speech. 
 
 

**​​****Thus, the correct sentence is: ***The teacher was happy to meet her and asked when she had completed all those.*
